titleZh: 《专利审查指南》（2023）修改解读（总览）
titleEn: Interpretation of the 2023 Amendments to the Patent Examination Guidelines (Overview)
sumZh: 汇总《专利审查指南》2023版修改的八个专题解读，涵盖发明/实用新型初审、专利权期限补偿、发明实审、计算机程序、中药、复审无效、外观设计及手续事务处理。
sumEn: An overview page linking to eight thematic interpretations of the 2023 Patent Examination Guidelines amendments covering preliminary examination, patent term compensation, computer programs, TCM, reexamination and procedures.

titleZh: 《专利审查指南》（2023）修改解读（一）：发明和实用新型初步审查及进入国家阶段的国际申请
titleEn: Interpretation (I): Preliminary Examination of Invention/Utility Model Applications and National Phase Entry
sumZh: 解读援引加入、超期优先权恢复、优先权要求增加或改正、不丧失新颖性公开等新制度及国际申请进入国家阶段的费用与程序修改。
sumEn: Explains new rules on incorporation by reference, restoration of priority, addition/correction of priority claims, and national-phase entry procedures and fees.

titleZh: 《专利审查指南》（2023）修改解读（二）：专利权期限的补偿
titleEn: Interpretation (II): Patent Term Compensation
sumZh: 解读发明专利授权延迟的期限补偿与药品专利期限补偿的计算公式、请求时机、合理延迟与申请人引起延迟的认定规则。
sumEn: Details the formulas, timing and rules for invention patent term adjustment and pharmaceutical patent term extension under Article 42 of the Patent Law.

titleZh: 《专利审查指南》（2023）修改解读（三）：发明专利申请实质审查的一般规定
titleEn: Interpretation (III): General Provisions on Substantive Examination of Invention Applications
sumZh: 解读诚实信用原则审查、互联网证据认定、新颖性宽限期、创造性“三步法”最接近现有技术及公知常识证据等实审规则修改。
sumEn: Explains amendments on good-faith examination, internet evidence, novelty grace period and the inventive-step three-step method in substantive examination.

titleZh: 《专利审查指南》（2023）修改解读（四）：涉及计算机程序的发明专利申请审查
titleEn: Interpretation (IV): Examination of Computer-Implemented Inventions
sumZh: 解读允许计算机程序产品作为权利要求主题，以及人工智能、大数据算法客体与创造性审查基准及用户体验提升的创造性考量。
sumEn: Explains allowing computer program product claims and the new subject-matter and inventive-step benchmarks for AI and big-data algorithms.

titleZh: 《专利审查指南》（2023）修改解读（五）：中药领域发明专利申请审查
titleEn: Interpretation (V): Examination of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) Inventions
sumZh: 解读新增中药领域审查专章，明确可授权客体、说明书与权利要求要求，以及新颖性、创造性、实用性的审查标准。
sumEn: Introduces the new TCM chapter setting subject-matter, disclosure requirements and novelty, inventiveness and utility standards for TCM inventions.

titleZh: 《专利审查指南》（2023）修改解读（六）：复审与无效请求的审查
titleEn: Interpretation (VI): Examination of Reexamination and Invalidation Requests
sumZh: 解读复审依职权审查情形扩充、无效程序当事人处置、权利要求修改原则、药品专利纠纷早期解决机制无效案件及口头审理方式优化。
sumEn: Explains expanded ex-officio reexamination review, invalidation handling, claim amendment rules, drug patent linkage cases and optimized oral hearings.

titleZh: 《专利审查指南》（2023）修改解读（七）：外观设计专利申请的初步审查及外观设计国际申请
titleEn: Interpretation (VII): Preliminary Examination of Design Applications and International Design Applications
sumZh: 解读局部外观设计、图形用户界面、外观设计本国优先权等初步审查规则，以及海牙协定下外观设计国际申请的事务处理与审查。
sumEn: Explains partial design and GUI rules, domestic priority for designs, and Hague Agreement international design application procedures.

titleZh: 《专利审查指南》（2023）修改解读（八）：专利申请手续和事务处理
titleEn: Interpretation (VIII): Application Procedures and Transaction Handling
sumZh: 解读著录项目变更批量办理、专利费用减缴与退款、送达日与期限起算、延迟审查、专利开放许可制度及专利权评价报告等手续修改。
sumEn: Explains batch bibliographic changes, fee reduction/refund rules, service dates, deferred examination, open licensing and patent evaluation reports.

titleZh: 国家知识产权局关于修改《专利审查指南》的决定（局令第84号）
titleEn: Decision on Amending the Patent Examination Guidelines (CNIPA Order No. 84)
sumZh: 公布2026年1月1日起施行的《专利审查指南》修改决定，共二十三项，涉及人工智能、比特流、植物品种定义及快速审查等制度。
sumEn: Announces 23 amendments to the Patent Examination Guidelines effective 2026-01-01, covering AI, bitstreams, plant variety definitions and expedited examination.

titleZh: 附对照表｜《专利审查指南》修改决定公布，2026年1月1日起施行
titleEn: Patent Examination Guidelines Amendment Published with Comparison Table, Effective 2026-01-01
sumZh: 知产力全文刊发《关于修改〈专利审查指南〉的决定》及修改对照表，梳理第八次修改的背景、主要内容与条款对照。
sumEn: Zhichanli publishes the full amendment decision with a clause-by-clause comparison table, outlining the eighth revision's background and content.

titleZh: 《专利审查指南》（2023）修改重点解读
titleEn: Key-Point Interpretation of the 2023 Patent Examination Guidelines Amendments
sumZh: 从申请审查程序、发明实审、计算机程序、中药、复审无效、外观设计及手续处理七个方面介绍2023版审查指南修改重点。
sumEn: Introduces the key 2023 amendments across application procedures, substantive examination, computer programs, TCM, reexamination, designs and procedures.

titleZh: 2026年中国国家知识产权局专利审查指南关键更新要点解析
titleEn: Analysis of Key Updates in the 2026 CNIPA Patent Examination Guidelines
sumZh: 从海外申请人视角解读创造性评估细化、修改标准趋严、支撑性与清晰度要求强化及人工智能等新兴技术审查指引扩展。
sumEn: Analyzes refined inventive-step assessment, stricter amendments, support/clarity requirements and expanded AI guidance from an overseas applicant perspective.

titleZh: 留言回复：多个申请人中部分未费减备案合格能否享受费用减缴
titleEn: Reply: Fee Reduction When Only Some Co-Applicants Pass Fee-Reduction Filing
sumZh: 明确须全体申请人均已费减备案合格并提交费用减缴请求或勾选请求费减，才符合《专利收费减缴办法》规定享受减缴。
sumEn: Clarifies that all co-applicants must pass fee-reduction filing before any fee reduction can be granted under the Patent Fee Reduction Measures.

titleZh: 留言回复：两个单位共同申请专利是否都需要办理费减备案
titleEn: Reply: Must All Joint Applicants Complete Fee-Reduction Filing?
sumZh: 明确所有申请人均需进行费减备案，并在备案合格后在专利请求书“全体申请人请求费用减缴”栏勾选，委托代理的由代理机构签章。
sumEn: States that every joint applicant must complete fee-reduction filing and tick the corresponding box in the request form.

srcZh: 乌兰察布市市场监督管理局

sumEn: Explains fee-reduction eligibility, materials, 85%/70% reduction rates, approval rules and the online filing steps in the patent business system.

sumEn: A plain-language guide to fee reduction conditions, rates, required materials and the online filing procedure for the 2025 cycle.

srcZh: 新疆维吾尔自治区市场监督管理局

sumEn: Requires that from 2026-01-01 all patent applications, reexamination and invalidation requests be filed in XML format, ending non-XML acceptance.

titleZh: 关于进一步推广使用可扩展标记语言（XML）格式提交专利电子申请文件的通知
titleEn: Notice on Further Promoting XML Format for Patent Electronic Applications
sumZh: 规定2025年10月1日后申请且请求优先审查、快速审查、PPH、延迟审查和集中审查的，须以XML格式提交电子申请。
sumEn: Requires XML filing for applications dated on/after 2025-10-01 that request prioritized, expedited, PPH, deferred or concentrated examination.

sumEn: Explains XML advantages, submission requirements, converter tools, implementation timeline and consequences of non-compliance.

titleZh: 留言回复：新版专利电子申请使用指南获取途径

sumEn: Points users to the electronic manual for the patent business system client under Help Documents - System Manuals.

titleZh: 留言回复：专利年费缴纳期限和滞纳金收取标准
titleEn: Reply: Annual Fee Payment Deadlines and Late-Payment Surcharge Rates
sumZh: 解答年费缴纳期限的计算及滞纳金收取标准，明确超期1至6个月分别按全额年费5%至25%分段加收滞纳金。
sumEn: Clarifies annual fee deadlines and the tiered surcharge of 5%-25% for late payment of one to six months.

titleZh: 专利年费管理：从缴费、减缴到补救，必读指南
titleEn: Patent Annual Fee Management: Payment, Reduction and Remedies
sumZh: 解答年费梯度递增、缴费时限、滞纳金计算、费减请求时机、忘缴后果及欠费补救等九个常见问题，并提出管理五步法。
sumEn: Answers nine common questions on annual fees, surcharges, fee-reduction timing and remedies, with a five-step management method.

titleZh: 专利授权后维护全指南：年费缴纳、核心注意事项及逾期后果

sumEn: Breaks down annual fee timing, channels, standards and reductions, plus the consequences of non-payment and the sole restoration opportunity.

titleZh: 最新！国知局专利收费标准及缴费服务指南
titleEn: Latest CNIPA Patent Fee Standards and Payment Service Guide
sumZh: 介绍修订后的《专利和集成电路布图设计缴费服务指南》，涵盖专利费用标准、缴费方式、退款及开放许可期间年费减免等内容。
sumEn: Summarizes the revised payment service guide covering fee standards, payment methods, refunds and annual-fee reduction during open licensing.

sumZh: 科普年费的年度计算方法、缴纳时间与方式，并以实例说明授权日与维持费/年费的关系及超期6个月补缴规则。
sumEn: Explains annual fee calculation, timing and payment, with examples of authorization date interplay and the six-month grace period.

titleZh: 专利年费怎么交？忘记缴费了还能补救吗？
titleEn: How to Pay Patent Annual Fees and Remedies After Missing Payment
sumZh: 梳理三种专利年费标准、缴费时间节点，详解6个月宽限期滞纳金、2个月恢复期及年费减缴政策的操作。
sumEn: Outlines annual fee standards and deadlines for all patent types, the six-month surcharge period, restoration window and fee-reduction policy.

titleZh: 国家知识产权局关于调整部分专利收费标准和减缴政策的公告（第594号）

sumEn: Sets patent term compensation fees and confirms a 15% annual-fee reduction during open licensing plus Hague design fee reductions.

titleZh: 国家知识产权局关于全面推进专利开放许可制度实施工作的通知
titleEn: CNIPA Notice on Fully Promoting Implementation of the Patent Open License System

sumEn: Deploys the open license system across nine areas including declarations, fee estimation, information sharing, matchmaking, filing and supervision.

titleZh: 知产科普｜专利开放许可实施合同备案合格后年费减缴年度和比例如何确定

sumEn: Illustrates the 15% reduction on unpaid annual fees after open-license filing, applying the higher of the 85% standard reduction and 15% open-license cut.

titleZh: 超详细专利网上缴费攻略（含步骤图）

sumEn: Walks through logging into the patent business system, selecting online payment, generating orders, paying and viewing e-receipts.

sumEn: Explains online payment in the patent business system or bank/postal remittance with supplementary electronic payment information.

srcZh: 北京市科学技术委员会、中关村科技园区管理委员会

titleEn: What to Note in Patent Maintenance and What Causes Patent Right Termination
sumZh: 科普年费缴纳与补缴滞纳金规则，列举期限届满、未缴费、主动放弃、被宣告无效等四种专利权终止情形。
sumEn: Explains annual fee payment and surcharges, and lists the four termination causes: expiry, non-payment, voluntary abandonment and invalidation.

titleZh: 专利权的维持与放弃有什么区别？
titleEn: Difference Between Maintaining and Abandoning a Patent Right
sumZh: 说明专利维持是通过缴纳费用使专利继续有效，而放弃是专利权人书面声明不再享有专利权，二者本质不同。
sumEn: Clarifies that maintenance keeps a patent in force by paying fees while abandonment is a written waiver terminating the right.

titleZh: 专利权的终止包括哪几种情况
titleEn: The Situations in Which a Patent Right Terminates
sumZh: 归纳专利权终止的三种情形：期限届满、未按规定缴纳年费、专利权人主动放弃，并说明终止后权利恢复的条件。
sumEn: Summarizes three termination causes (expiry, non-payment, voluntary abandonment) and the conditions for restoring rights.

titleZh: 国家知识产权局关于调整部分专利收费标准和减缴政策的公告（第594号）

sumEn: Provides the submission address, required materials and payment channels (online or bank/postal remittance) for reexamination and restoration requests.

titleZh: 留言回复：复审是否收费及复审的意义
titleEn: Reply: Reexamination Fees and the Value of Reexamination
sumZh: 解答复审需缴纳复审费及三种复审决定类型，说明撤销驳回决定后审查部门不得以同样事实理由证据再次驳回。
sumEn: Explains reexamination fees and the three decision types, noting examiners cannot re-reject on the same facts and evidence after reversal.

titleZh: 2026年专利申请复审有哪些规定？
titleEn: What Are the 2026 Rules for Patent Application Reexamination?
sumZh: 归纳复审请求客体、请求人资格、提出期限、文件形式与费用标准，明确发明复审费1000元、实用新型/外观设计300元。
sumEn: Summarizes reexamination subject matter, requester qualifications, deadlines, document requirements and fees (1000 yuan for inventions, 300 for others).

titleZh: 夯实人才基础 紧跟发展动向：2025年度专利代理师资格考试顺利举办
titleEn: Building Talent and Following Trends: 2025 Patent Agent Qualification Exam Held
sumZh: 报道2025年度专利代理师资格考试情况，解读新考试大纲对复合型高端知识产权人才的选拔导向及考试保障服务。
sumEn: Reports on the 2025 patent agent qualification exam and its revised syllabus aimed at selecting high-end composite IP professionals.

titleZh: 《全国知识产权代理行业发展状况（2023年）》显示：我国知识产权代理行业稳步发展
titleEn: 2023 Report Shows Steady Development of China's IP Agency Industry
sumZh: 发布2023年专利代理机构、专利代理师、商标代理机构及考试数据，呈现行业规模、区域分布、审批服务优化与能力建设情况。
sumEn: Releases 2023 data on patent agencies, patent agents, trademark agencies and exams, showing scale, regional distribution and service improvement.

titleZh: 关于提交专利代理机构2025年度报告的通知
titleEn: Notice on Submitting 2025 Annual Reports by Patent Agencies
sumZh: 部署上海市专利代理机构2025年度报告提交工作，说明填报时间、方式及未按时提交将被列入经营异常名录的后果。
sumEn: Deploys 2025 annual report filing for Shanghai patent agencies, explaining timing, method and consequences of late submission.
